customCommands.name: suit
customCommands.description: SuitOS Agent Operating System — consult registry, load workflows, run validations

customCommands.name: suit:registry
customCommands.description: Query the SuitOS registry — agents, skills, workflows, projects, models, routing
customCommands.prompt: Read .suit/registry/{{query}}.yaml and summarize its contents. Query: {{query}}

customCommands.name: suit:workflow
customCommands.description: Load a SuitOS workflow definition for the current task
customCommands.prompt: Read .suit/workflows/{{workflow}}.yaml and use it as the process for this task. Workflow: {{workflow}}

customCommands.name: suit:validate
customCommands.description: Run SuitOS review profile checks on the current changes
customCommands.prompt: Load .suit/reviewer/profiles.yaml, select the {{profile}} profile, and run its checks on the changes made. Profile: {{profile}}

customCommands.name: suit:memory
customCommands.description: Write an Architecture Decision Record to SuitOS memory
customCommands.prompt: Write a new ADR to .suit/memory/decisions/ADR-{{number}}-{{title}}.md following SuitOS conventions. Title: {{title}}, Decision: {{decision}}

customCommands.name: suit:plan
customCommands.description: Create a SuitOS execution plan using planner template
customCommands.prompt: Load .suit/planner/template.yaml, create a plan for this task, and present it for approval before executing. Task: {{task}}
